contents: Import an image by dragging and dropping from your computer, or clicking and selecting one in the dialog box.
JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP and SVG formats are supported.
Select the area you want to convert into a pattern, then click OK.
To use the whole image without selecting an area, click Auto-Resize.
There are some advanced options such as specifying palette colours and grid sizes and setting
the maximum number of colours to use.
Once you're happy with the settings, click Convert.

Once conversion is complete, your image will be displayed as a grid pattern, with button controls for various view options. The converted image will be saved until you click the Clear button, even if you close the browser window.
You'll get better results if you crop your image in advance to focus on the part you need, and reduce the number of colours used if possible.
If you want a particular colour but it isn't surviving the conversion process, try filling the background of the image in with that colour beforehand to force it through.
This tool is designed to assist you in drawing patterns in the game, and as such, it does not support QR Code output.
The Animal Crossing: New Leaf Custom Design Assistant is provided free of charge by hayu.
hayu assumes no responsibility for data loss or any other issues arising from the use of this tool. Use at your own risk.
